CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.analytics_billing_rows(p_from date, p_to date, p_agency uuid, p_organization uuid, p_brand uuid, p_project uuid, p_currency text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, number text, project_id uuid, document_date date, due_date date, currency text, status text, total_amount numeric, paid_amount numeric, remaining_amount numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 perform app_private.analytics_validate(p_from,p_to);
 if p_currency is not null and p_currency !~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' then
  raise exception using errcode='22023',message='invalid_analytics_currency'; end if;
 -- Validate the same operational scope, then require the extra financial permission.
 perform 1 from app_private.analytics_scope(p_agency,p_organization,p_brand,p_project);
 if not exists(select 1 from public.my_capabilities() c where c.capability_key='analytics.view_billing')
  or not exists(select 1 from public.my_capabilities() c where c.capability_key='billing.view')
  or (p_project is not null and (not app_private.project_permission(p_project,'analytics.view_billing') or not app_private.project_permission(p_project,'billing.view'))) then
  raise exception using errcode='42501',message='analytics_billing_forbidden'; end if;
 return query with scope as materialized (select s.* from app_private.analytics_scope(p_agency,p_organization,p_brand,p_project) s
  where app_private.project_permission(s.project_id,'analytics.view_billing') and app_private.project_permission(s.project_id,'billing.view')),
 docs as materialized (select d.* from public.billing_documents d join public.organizations o on o.id=d.organization_id
  where d.status in ('issued','partially_paid','paid') and d.date between p_from and p_to
   and (p_currency is null or d.currency=p_currency) and (p_agency is null or o.agency_id=p_agency)
   and (p_organization is null or o.id=p_organization) and (p_project is null or d.project_id=p_project)
   and (p_brand is null or coalesce((select p.brand_id from public.projects p where p.id=d.project_id),d.brand_id)=p_brand)
   and ((d.project_id is not null and exists(select 1 from scope s where s.project_id=d.project_id))
    or (d.project_id is null and p_project is null and public.has_capability('analytics.view_billing',o.agency_id,o.id)
     and public.has_capability('billing.view',o.agency_id,o.id) and exists(select 1 from public.agency_memberships am
      where am.agency_id=o.agency_id and am.user_id=auth.uid() and am.status='active' and am.role_key='agency_director')))),
 payments as (select pr.billing_document_id,sum(pr.amount) as paid from public.payment_records pr join docs d on d.id=pr.billing_document_id
  where pr.voided_at is null and pr.currency=d.currency group by pr.billing_document_id)
 select d.id,d.number,d.project_id,d.date,d.due_date,d.currency,d.status::text,d.total_amount,
  coalesce(pr.paid,0),greatest(d.total_amount-coalesce(pr.paid,0),0)
 from docs d left join payments pr on pr.billing_document_id=d.id;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.analytics_scope(p_agency uuid, p_organization uuid, p_brand uuid, p_project uuid, p_capability text DEFAULT 'analytics.view'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(project_id uuid, project_name text, project_status text, brand_id uuid, brand_name text, organization_id uuid, organization_name text, agency_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if auth.uid() is null or not public.is_internal_actor() or not exists(select 1 from public.my_capabilities() c where c.capability_key=p_capability) then
  raise exception using errcode='42501',message='analytics_forbidden'; end if;
 if p_project is not null and not app_private.project_permission(p_project,p_capability) then
  raise exception using errcode='42501',message='analytics_scope_forbidden'; end if;
 if p_agency is not null and not exists(select 1 from public.agency_memberships am
  where am.agency_id=p_agency and am.user_id=auth.uid() and am.status='active') then
  raise exception using errcode='42501',message='analytics_scope_forbidden'; end if;
 return query select p.id,p.name,p.status,b.id,b.name,o.id,o.name,o.agency_id
 from public.projects p join public.brands b on b.id=p.brand_id
 join public.organizations o on o.id=b.organization_id
 join public.agency_memberships am on am.agency_id=o.agency_id and am.user_id=auth.uid() and am.status='active'
 where am.role_key in ('agency_director','project_manager')
  and app_private.project_permission(p.id,p_capability) and app_private.project_permission(p.id,'project.view')
  and (p_agency is null or o.agency_id=p_agency)
  and (p_organization is null or o.id=p_organization)
  and (p_brand is null or b.id=p_brand) and (p_project is null or p.id=p_project);
 -- Never turn an explicit foreign Organization/Brand/Project into an agency total.
 if (p_organization is not null or p_brand is not null or p_project is not null) and not found then
  raise exception using errcode='42501',message='analytics_scope_forbidden'; end if;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.channel_access(p_channel uuid, p_actor uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select p_actor is not null and exists (
  select 1 from public.channels c
  join public.organizations o on o.id=c.organization_id
  join public.channel_memberships m on m.channel_id=c.id and m.user_id=p_actor and m.status='active'
  where c.id=p_channel and c.archived_at is null and o.lifecycle='active_client'
   and (c.kind='organization' or exists (
     select 1 from public.projects p join public.brands b on b.id=p.brand_id
     where p.id=c.project_id and p.archived_at is null and b.organization_id=c.organization_id))
   and (
    (m.member_kind='client' and exists (
      select 1 from public.client_memberships cm where cm.user_id=p_actor
       and cm.organization_id=c.organization_id and cm.status='active')
      and (c.kind='organization' or exists (
       select 1 from public.project_memberships pm where pm.project_id=c.project_id
        and pm.user_id=p_actor and pm.member_type='client' and pm.status='active')))
    or
    (m.member_kind='internal' and exists (
      select 1 from public.agency_memberships am where am.user_id=p_actor
       and am.agency_id=o.agency_id and am.status='active'
       and (am.role_key='agency_director' or
        (c.kind='organization' and exists (
          select 1 from public.capability_grants cg where cg.user_id=p_actor
           and cg.organization_id=c.organization_id and cg.capability_key='channel.view'
           and cg.revoked_at is null and (cg.expires_at is null or cg.expires_at>now()))
         or c.kind='project')))
      and (c.kind='organization' or exists (
       select 1 from public.project_memberships pm where pm.project_id=c.project_id
        and pm.user_id=p_actor and pm.member_type='internal' and pm.status='active')
       or exists (select 1 from public.agency_memberships am where am.user_id=p_actor
        and am.agency_id=o.agency_id and am.status='active' and am.role_key='agency_director')))
   )
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.file_mime_allowed(p_mime text, p_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case lower(p_mime)
  when 'image/jpeg' then lower(p_name) ~ '\.(jpg|jpeg)$'
  when 'image/png' then lower(p_name) ~ '\.png$'
  when 'image/webp' then lower(p_name) ~ '\.webp$'
  when 'video/mp4' then lower(p_name) ~ '\.mp4$'
  when 'video/quicktime' then lower(p_name) ~ '\.mov$'
  when 'application/pdf' then lower(p_name) ~ '\.pdf$'
  when 'application/msword' then lower(p_name) ~ '\.doc$'
  when 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document' then lower(p_name) ~ '\.docx$'
  when 'application/vnd.ms-excel' then lower(p_name) ~ '\.xls$'
  when 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' then lower(p_name) ~ '\.xlsx$'
  when 'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint' then lower(p_name) ~ '\.ppt$'
  when 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation' then lower(p_name) ~ '\.pptx$'
  else false end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.mark_invitation_dispatched(p_invitation_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  invitation public.invitations%rowtype;
  correlation uuid := gen_random_uuid();
begin
  select i.* into invitation
  from public.invitations as i
  where i.id = p_invitation_id
  for update;

  if not found or invitation.status <> 'pending' then
    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'invitation_not_pending';
  end if;

  if invitation.email_sent_at is null then
    update public.invitations
    set email_sent_at = now()
    where id = invitation.id;

    perform app_private.emit_event(
      case invitation.kind
        when 'internal' then 'agency.member.invitation_dispatched'
        else 'client.member.invitation_dispatched'
      end,
      invitation.invited_by,
      'invitation',
      invitation.id,
      invitation.agency_id,
      invitation.organization_id,
      correlation,
      null,
      jsonb_build_object('kind', invitation.kind)
    );
  end if;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_variable
begin
  if tg_table_name='review_assignments' then
    if old.status<>'pending' or
      (new.id,new.review_round_id,new.requirement_id,new.reviewer_id,new.requirement_scope,new.created_at)
      is distinct from
      (old.id,old.review_round_id,old.requirement_id,old.reviewer_id,old.requirement_scope,old.created_at)
      or new.status not in ('approved','changes_requested','overridden') then
      raise exception using errcode='23514',message='review_history_immutable'; end if;
  elsif tg_table_name='review_rounds' then
    if old.status<>'pending' or
      (new.id,new.deliverable_version_id,new.context,new.opened_at)
      is distinct from (old.id,old.deliverable_version_id,old.context,old.opened_at)
      or new.status not in ('approved','changes_requested') then
      raise exception using errcode='23514',message='review_history_immutable'; end if;
  elsif tg_table_name='review_requirements' then
    if not old.active or new.active or new.retired_at is null or
      (new.id,new.project_id,new.deliverable_id,new.reviewer_id,new.created_by,new.created_at)
      is distinct from (old.id,old.project_id,old.deliverable_id,old.reviewer_id,old.created_by,old.created_at)
    then raise exception using errcode='23514',message='review_history_immutable'; end if;
  elsif tg_table_name='deliverables' then
    if (new.id,new.project_id,new.work_item_id,new.created_by,new.create_key,new.created_at)
      is distinct from (old.id,old.project_id,old.work_item_id,old.created_by,old.create_key,old.created_at)
    then raise exception using errcode='23514',message='deliverable_relationship_immutable'; end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end; $function$

 with scope as materialized (select * from app_private.analytics_scope(p_agency,p_organization,p_brand,p_project)),
 work as materialized (select w.* from public.work_items w join scope s on s.project_id=w.project_id where w.archived_at is null),
 deliveries as (select d.* from public.deliverables d join scope s on s.project_id=d.project_id where d.archived_at is null)
 select jsonb_build_object('active_projects',(select count(*) from scope where project_status='active'),
 'active_clients',(select count(distinct s.organization_id) from scope s join public.organizations o on o.id=s.organization_id where o.lifecycle='active_client'),
 'open_work',(select count(*) from work where status not in ('done','cancelled')),
 'overdue_work',(select count(*) from work where status not in ('done','cancelled') and due_at<now()),
 'blocked_work',(select count(*) from work where status='blocked'),
 'pending_internal',(select count(*) from deliveries where status='in_review'),
 'pending_client',(select count(*) from public.client_reviews r join public.client_publications cp on cp.id=r.publication_id
  join scope s on s.project_id=cp.project_id where r.status='pending'),
 'completed_period',(select count(*) from work where status='done' and completed_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City'
  and completed_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City'),
 'completed_previous',(select count(*) from work where status='done' and completed_at>=(p_from-(p_to-p_from+1))::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City'
  and completed_at<p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City'),

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.analytics_projects(p_from date, p_to date, p_agency uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_organization uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_brand uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_project uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
 perform app_private.analytics_validate(p_from,p_to,p_limit,p_offset);
 with scope as materialized (select * from app_private.analytics_scope(p_agency,p_organization,p_brand,p_project)),
 work as (select w.project_id,count(*) filter(where w.status not in ('done','cancelled')) as open_work,
  count(*) filter(where w.status='blocked') as blocked_work,
  count(*) filter(where w.status not in ('done','cancelled') and w.due_at<now()) as overdue_work,
  count(*) filter(where w.completed_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' and w.completed_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City') as completed_period
  from public.work_items w join scope s on s.project_id=w.project_id where w.archived_at is null group by w.project_id),
 milestones as (select m.project_id,count(*) filter(where m.status in ('completed','closed')) as done,
  count(*) filter(where m.status in ('planned','in_progress')) as pending
  from public.milestones m join scope s on s.project_id=m.project_id where m.archived_at is null group by m.project_id),
 activity as (select w.project_id,count(*) as activity_period,max(e.occurred_at) as last_activity
  from public.work_item_events e join public.work_items w on w.id=e.work_item_id join scope s on s.project_id=w.project_id
  where e.occurred_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' and e.occurred_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' group by w.project_id),
 rows as (select s.*,coalesce(w.open_work,0) as open_work,coalesce(w.blocked_work,0) as blocked_work,
  coalesce(w.overdue_work,0) as overdue_work,coalesce(w.completed_period,0) as completed_period,
  coalesce(m.done,0) as milestones_done,coalesce(m.pending,0) as milestones_pending,
  coalesce(a.activity_period,0) as activity_period,a.last_activity
  from scope s left join work w on w.project_id=s.project_id left join milestones m on m.project_id=s.project_id
  left join activity a on a.project_id=s.project_id order by s.project_name,s.project_id limit p_limit offset p_offset)
 select jsonb_build_object('items',coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(rows)),'[]'::jsonb),'total',(select count(*) from scope),
 'statuses',(select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(project_status,n),'{}'::jsonb) from (select project_status,count(*) n from scope group by project_status) x),'as_of',now()) into result from rows;
 return result;
end; $function$

 'submitted_period',(select count(*) from versions where submitted_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' and submitted_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City'),
 'internal_approved_period',(select count(*) from rounds where status='approved' and closed_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' and closed_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City'),

 'published_period',(select count(*) from client where published_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' and published_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City'),
 'client_approved_period',(select count(*) from client where status='approved' and closed_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' and closed_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City'),

 'pending_internal',(select count(*) from rounds where status='pending'),'pending_client',(select count(*) from client where status='pending'),

  from rounds where closed_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' and closed_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' and closed_at>=opened_at),

  from client where closed_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' and closed_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' and closed_at>=opened_at),
 'median_versions',(select percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by n) from (select count(v.id) n from deliveries d left join versions v on v.deliverable_id=d.id group by d.id) x),'as_of',now()) into result;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.analytics_work(p_from date, p_to date, p_agency uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_organization uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_brand uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_project uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb; bucket text:=case when p_to-p_from<31 then 'day' when p_to-p_from<181 then 'week' else 'month' end;
begin
 perform app_private.analytics_validate(p_from,p_to);
 with scope as materialized (select * from app_private.analytics_scope(p_agency,p_organization,p_brand,p_project)),
 work as materialized (select w.* from public.work_items w join scope s on s.project_id=w.project_id where w.archived_at is null),
 completions as materialized (select * from work where status='done' and completed_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City'
  and completed_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City'),
 days as (select distinct date_trunc(bucket,d)::date as day from generate_series(p_from::timestamp,p_to::timestamp,interval '1 day') d),
 series as (select days.day,count(c.id) as count from days left join completions c
  on date_trunc(bucket,c.completed_at at time zone 'America/Mexico_City')::date=days.day group by days.day order by days.day)
 select jsonb_build_object('statuses',(select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(status,n),'{}'::jsonb) from (select status,count(*) n from work group by status) x),
 'priorities',(select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(priority,n),'{}'::jsonb) from (select priority,count(*) n from work where status not in ('done','cancelled') group by priority) x),
 'completed_period',(select count(*) from completions),
 'median_completion_days',(select round((percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by extract(epoch from completed_at-created_at)/86400))::numeric,1) from completions where completed_at>=created_at),
 'median_open_age_days',(select round((percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by extract(epoch from now()-created_at)/86400))::numeric,1) from work where status not in ('done','cancelled') and created_at<=now()),
 'series',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(series)),'[]'::jsonb) from series),'bucket',bucket,'as_of',now()) into result;
 return result;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.analytics_work_details(p_from date, p_to date, p_agency uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_organization uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_brand uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_project uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_filter text DEFAULT 'overdue'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
 perform app_private.analytics_validate(p_from,p_to,p_limit,p_offset);
 if p_filter is null or p_filter not in ('open','overdue','blocked','completed') then
  raise exception using errcode='22023',message='invalid_analytics_filter'; end if;
 with scope as materialized (select * from app_private.analytics_scope(p_agency,p_organization,p_brand,p_project)),
 filtered as materialized (select w.id,w.project_id,s.project_name,w.title,w.status,w.priority,w.due_at,w.completed_at from public.work_items w
  join scope s on s.project_id=w.project_id where w.archived_at is null and case p_filter
   when 'open' then w.status not in ('done','cancelled') when 'overdue' then w.status not in ('done','cancelled') and w.due_at<now()
   when 'blocked' then w.status='blocked' when 'completed' then w.status='done'
    and w.completed_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' and w.completed_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' end),
 rows as (select * from filtered order by due_at nulls last,id limit p_limit offset p_offset)
 select jsonb_build_object('items',coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(rows)),'[]'::jsonb),'total',(select count(*) from filtered),'as_of',now()) into result from rows;
 return result;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.client_project_report(p_report uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare report public.project_reports%rowtype; result jsonb;
begin
 select * into report from public.project_reports r where r.id=p_report and r.published_at is not null;
 if report.id is null or not app_private.client_project_access(report.project_id) or not public.has_capability('report.view_client',null,
  (select b.organization_id from public.projects p join public.brands b on b.id=p.brand_id where p.id=report.project_id)) then
  raise exception using errcode='42501',message='report_forbidden'; end if;
 select jsonb_build_object('id',report.id,'title',report.title,'project_id',p.id,'project_name',p.name,'project_status',p.status,
 'from',report.from_date,'to',report.to_date,'published_at',report.published_at,'as_of',now(),'semantics','current_report',
 'milestones_done',(select count(*) from public.milestones m where m.project_id=p.id and m.archived_at is null and m.status in ('completed','closed')),
 'milestones_pending',(select count(*) from public.milestones m where m.project_id=p.id and m.archived_at is null and m.status in ('planned','in_progress')),
 'published_deliverables',(select count(distinct cp.deliverable_id) from public.client_publications cp where cp.project_id=p.id
  and cp.published_at>=report.from_date::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' and cp.published_at<(report.to_date+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City'),
 'approvals',(select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(status,n),'{}'::jsonb) from
  (select cr.status,count(*) n from public.client_reviews cr join public.client_publications cp on cp.id=cr.publication_id
   where cp.project_id=p.id and cp.published_at>=report.from_date::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City'
    and cp.published_at<(report.to_date+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' group by cr.status) x),
 'published_documents',(select count(*) from public.billing_documents d where d.project_id=p.id and d.published_to_client and d.status in ('issued','partially_paid','paid')
  and d.published_at>=report.from_date::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City' and d.published_at<(report.to_date+1)::timestamp at time zone 'America/Mexico_City'))
 into result from public.projects p where p.id=report.project_id;
 return result;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deliverable_detail(work_item_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_variable
declare v_work public.work_items%rowtype; v_deliverable public.deliverables%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_work from public.work_items wi where wi.id=work_item_id;
  select * into v_deliverable from public.deliverables d where d.work_item_id=work_item_id;
  if v_work.id is null or (not app_private.can_read_work_item(work_item_id)
    and (v_deliverable.id is null or not app_private.phase7_read_allowed(v_deliverable.id))) then
    raise exception using errcode='42501',message='deliverable_detail_forbidden'; end if;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'work',jsonb_build_object('id',v_work.id,'project_id',v_work.project_id,
      'title',v_work.title,'status',v_work.status,'archived_at',v_work.archived_at),
    'deliverable',case when v_deliverable.id is null then null else
      jsonb_build_object('id',v_deliverable.id,'title',v_deliverable.title,
        'status',v_deliverable.status,'created_at',v_deliverable.created_at,
        'published_at',v_deliverable.published_at) end,
    'can_create',v_deliverable.id is null and app_private.phase7_can_submit(work_item_id,'deliverable.create'),
    'can_submit',v_deliverable.id is not null and v_deliverable.status in ('draft','changes_requested')
      and app_private.phase7_can_submit(work_item_id,'deliverable.submit'),
    'can_publish',v_deliverable.status='ready_for_client'
      and app_private.project_permission(v_work.project_id,'deliverable.publish'),
    'can_override',app_private.project_permission(v_work.project_id,'review.override')
      and exists(select 1 from public.projects p join public.brands b on b.id=p.brand_id
        join public.organizations o on o.id=b.organization_id
        join public.agency_memberships am on am.agency_id=o.agency_id
        where p.id=v_work.project_id and am.user_id=(select auth.uid())
          and am.status='active' and am.role_key='agency_director'),
    'versions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',dv.id,'version_number',dv.version_number,'notes',dv.notes,
      'submitted_at',dv.submitted_at,'submitted_by',dv.submitted_by,
      'submitter_name',coalesce(sp.display_name,'Miembro'),
      'round',jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'status',r.status,'opened_at',r.opened_at,
        'closed_at',r.closed_at,'assignments',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id',a.id,'reviewer_id',a.reviewer_id,'reviewer_name',coalesce(rp.display_name,'Miembro'),
          'requirement_id',a.requirement_id,'requirement_scope',a.requirement_scope,
          'status',a.status,'resolved_at',a.resolved_at,
          'decision',rd.decision,'reason',rd.reason,'decided_at',rd.decided_at,
          'override_reason',ro.reason,'overridden_at',ro.overridden_at,
          'override_director_id',ro.director_id
        ) order by a.created_at,a.id) from public.review_assignments a
          left join public.profiles rp on rp.user_id=a.reviewer_id
          left join public.review_decisions rd on rd.review_assignment_id=a.id
          left join public.review_overrides ro on ro.review_assignment_id=a.id
          where a.review_round_id=r.id),'[]'::jsonb))
      ) order by dv.version_number desc)
      from public.deliverable_versions dv join public.review_rounds r on r.deliverable_version_id=dv.id
      left join public.profiles sp on sp.user_id=dv.submitted_by
      where dv.deliverable_id=v_deliverable.id),'[]'::jsonb)
  );
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.editorial_calendar(date_from date, date_to date, project_filter uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, state_filter text DEFAULT NULL::text, channel_filter text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(item_id uuid, project_id uuid, project_name text, brand_name text, cycle_id uuid, work_item_id uuid, title text, brief text, scheduled_date date, scheduled_time time without time zone, channel text, format text, planning_state text, template_id uuid, assignee_names text[], own_application_status text, can_manage boolean, can_apply boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not app_private.is_internal_actor() then
    raise exception using errcode='42501', message='editorial_view_forbidden';
  end if;
  if date_from is null or date_to is null
    or date_to < date_from or date_to > date_from + 93
    or (state_filter is not null and state_filter not in ('planned','available','assigned','cancelled'))
    or (channel_filter is not null and channel_filter not in ('instagram','facebook','tiktok','linkedin','youtube','website','other')) then
    raise exception using errcode='22023', message='invalid_editorial_window';
  end if;
  if project_filter is not null and not app_private.editorial_permission(project_filter,'editorial.view') then
    raise exception using errcode='42501', message='editorial_view_forbidden';
  end if;
  return query
  select ei.id,p.id,p.name,b.name,ei.cycle_id,ei.work_item_id,ei.title,ei.brief,
    ei.scheduled_date,ei.scheduled_time,ei.channel,ei.format,ei.planning_state,ei.template_id,
    coalesce(assignees.names,'{}'::text[]), own.status,
    app_private.editorial_permission(p.id,'editorial.update'),
    ei.planning_state='available' and app_private.editorial_permission(p.id,'editorial.apply')
      and app_private.editorial_applicant_eligible(p.id,(select auth.uid()))
  from public.editorial_items ei join public.projects p on p.id=ei.project_id
  join public.brands b on b.id=p.brand_id
  left join lateral (select array_agg(coalesce(pr.display_name,au.email,wia.user_id::text) order by wia.user_id) names
    from public.work_item_assignees wia left join public.profiles pr on pr.user_id=wia.user_id
    left join auth.users au on au.id=wia.user_id
    where wia.work_item_id=ei.work_item_id and wia.revoked_at is null) assignees on true
  left join public.work_applications own on own.editorial_item_id=ei.id and own.applicant_id=(select auth.uid())
  where ei.scheduled_date between date_from and date_to and ei.archived_at is null
    and (project_filter is null or ei.project_id=project_filter)
    and (state_filter is null or ei.planning_state=state_filter)
    and (channel_filter is null or ei.channel=channel_filter)
    and app_private.editorial_permission(ei.project_id,'editorial.view')
  order by ei.scheduled_date,ei.scheduled_time nulls last,ei.id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_capability(capability_key text, agency_scope uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, organization_scope uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select (select auth.uid()) is not null and exists (
    select 1
    from public.agency_memberships as am
    join public.role_capabilities as rc on rc.role_key = am.role_key
    where am.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and am.status = 'active'
      and rc.capability_key = $1
      and ($2 is null or am.agency_id = $2)

    union all

    select 1
    from public.capability_grants as cg
    where cg.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and cg.capability_key = $1
      and exists(select 1 from public.agency_memberships active_member where active_member.user_id=cg.user_id
      and active_member.agency_id=cg.agency_id and active_member.status='active')
      and cg.revoked_at is null
      and (cg.expires_at is null or cg.expires_at > now())
      and ($2 is null or cg.agency_id = $2)
      and (
        (cg.scope_kind = 'agency' and $3 is null)
        or (cg.scope_kind = 'agency' and $3 is not null)
        or (cg.scope_kind = 'organization' and cg.organization_id = $3)
      )

    union all

    select 1
    from public.client_memberships as cm
    join public.role_capabilities as rc on rc.role_key = cm.role_key
    where cm.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and cm.status = 'active'
      and rc.capability_key = $1
      and $3 is not null
      and cm.organization_id = $3
  );
$function$

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_variable
declare v_d public.deliverables%rowtype;
begin
 select * into v_d from public.deliverables d where d.work_item_id=work_item_id;
 if v_d.id is null or not (app_private.phase7_read_allowed(v_d.id)
  or app_private.project_permission(v_d.project_id,'deliverable.publish')) then
  raise exception using errcode='42501',message='client_history_forbidden'; end if;
 return coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('publication_id',cp.id,
  'version_number',dv.version_number,'published_at',cp.published_at,'review_status',cr.status,
  'decisions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('decision',cd.decision,
   'reason',cd.reason,'decided_at',cd.decided_at,'reviewer_name',coalesce(pr.display_name,'Cliente'))
   order by cd.decided_at,cd.id) from public.client_review_assignments a
   join public.client_review_decisions cd on cd.assignment_id=a.id
   left join public.profiles pr on pr.user_id=cd.reviewer_id where a.client_review_id=cr.id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'feedback',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('body',cf.body,'created_at',cf.created_at,
   'author_name',coalesce(pr.display_name,'Cliente')) order by cf.created_at,cf.id)
   from public.client_feedback cf left join public.profiles pr on pr.user_id=cf.author_id
   where cf.publication_id=cp.id),'[]'::jsonb)) order by cp.published_at desc,cp.id desc)
 from public.client_publications cp join public.deliverable_versions dv on dv.id=cp.version_id
 join public.client_reviews cr on cr.publication_id=cp.id where cp.deliverable_id=v_d.id),'[]'::jsonb);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_projects(search_text text DEFAULT ''::text, status_filter text DEFAULT ''::text, page_limit integer DEFAULT 20, page_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(project_id uuid, project_name text, project_description text, project_status text, start_date date, target_end_date date, brand_id uuid, brand_name text, organization_id uuid, organization_name text, lead_name text, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not app_private.is_internal_actor() then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'project_list_forbidden';
  end if;
  if page_limit not between 1 and 100 or page_offset < 0
    or (status_filter <> '' and status_filter not in ('planning','active','on_hold','completed','archived')) then
    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'invalid_project_list_input';
  end if;

  return query
  select p.id, p.name, p.description, p.status, p.start_date, p.target_end_date,
    b.id, b.name, o.id, o.name,
    lead.display_name,
    count(*) over ()
  from public.projects as p
  join public.brands as b on b.id = p.brand_id
  join public.organizations as o on o.id = b.organization_id
  left join lateral (
    select coalesce(pr.display_name, au.email, pm.user_id::text) as display_name
    from public.project_memberships as pm
    left join public.profiles as pr on pr.user_id = pm.user_id
    left join auth.users as au on au.id = pm.user_id
    where pm.project_id = p.id and pm.status = 'active'
      and pm.member_type = 'internal' and pm.responsibility = 'lead'
    order by pm.created_at, pm.id
    limit 1
  ) as lead on true
  where app_private.project_permission(p.id, 'project.view')
    and (
      (status_filter = '' and p.archived_at is null)
      or p.status = status_filter
    )
    and (
      btrim(search_text) = ''
      or p.name ilike '%' || btrim(search_text) || '%'
      or b.name ilike '%' || btrim(search_text) || '%'
      or o.name ilike '%' || btrim(search_text) || '%'
    )
  order by p.created_at desc, p.id desc
  limit page_limit offset page_offset;
end;
$function$

      and cg.revoked_at is null

    select rc.capability_key, 'organization'::text, cm.organization_id
    from public.client_memberships as cm
    join public.role_capabilities as rc on rc.role_key = cm.role_key

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select c.id,c.kind,c.organization_id,c.project_id,
  case when c.kind='organization' then o.name||' · General' else p.name end,
  lm.created_at,left(lm.body,120),
  (select count(*) from public.messages m where m.channel_id=c.id and m.author_user_id<>auth.uid()
   and m.created_at>coalesce(cm.last_read_at,cm.created_at))
 from public.channel_memberships cm join public.channels c on c.id=cm.channel_id
 join public.organizations o on o.id=c.organization_id
 left join public.projects p on p.id=c.project_id
 left join lateral (select m.created_at,m.body from public.messages m where m.channel_id=c.id
  order by m.created_at desc,m.id desc limit 1) lm on true
 where cm.user_id=auth.uid() and cm.status='active' and app_private.channel_access(c.id)
 order by lm.created_at desc nulls last,c.created_at desc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_space_items()
 RETURNS TABLE(item_kind text, item_id uuid, item_type text, title text, description text, status text, priority text, due_at timestamp with time zone, bucket text, project_id uuid, project_name text, brand_name text, organization_name text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  local_today date := (now() at time zone 'America/Mexico_City')::date;
begin
  if actor is null or not app_private.is_internal_actor() then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'my_space_forbidden';
  end if;

  return query
  with unified as (
    select 'project'::text as item_kind, wi.id as item_id, 'assigned'::text as item_type,
      wi.title, wi.description, wi.status, wi.priority, wi.due_at,
      wi.project_id, p.name as project_name, b.name as brand_name, o.name as organization_name
    from public.work_item_assignees as wia
    join public.work_items as wi on wi.id = wia.work_item_id
    join public.projects as p on p.id = wi.project_id
    join public.brands as b on b.id = p.brand_id
    join public.organizations as o on o.id = b.organization_id
    join public.project_memberships as pm
      on pm.project_id = p.id and pm.user_id = actor
      and pm.member_type = 'internal' and pm.status = 'active'
    where wia.user_id = actor and wia.revoked_at is null
      and wi.archived_at is null and wi.status not in ('done', 'cancelled')
      and p.archived_at is null

    union all

    select 'personal', pi.id, pi.item_type, pi.title, pi.description,
      pi.status, pi.priority, pi.due_at, null, null, null, null
    from public.personal_work_items as pi
    where pi.user_id = actor and pi.archived_at is null and pi.status = 'open'
  )
  select u.item_kind, u.item_id, u.item_type, u.title, u.description,
    u.status, u.priority, u.due_at,
    case
      when u.due_at is null then 'no_due_date'
      when (u.due_at at time zone 'America/Mexico_City')::date < local_today then 'overdue'
      when (u.due_at at time zone 'America/Mexico_City')::date = local_today then 'today'
      else 'upcoming'
    end,
    u.project_id, u.project_name, u.brand_name, u.organization_name
  from unified as u
  order by
    case
      when u.due_at is null then 3
      when (u.due_at at time zone 'America/Mexico_City')::date < local_today then 0
      when (u.due_at at time zone 'America/Mexico_City')::date = local_today then 1
      else 2
    end,
    case u.priority when 'urgent' then 0 when 'high' then 1 when 'normal' then 2 else 3 end,
    u.due_at nulls last, u.item_id;
end;
$function$

  'review_status',cr.status,'my_assignment_id',a.id,'my_assignment_status',a.status,
  'files',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',fa.id,
   'bucket_id',fa.bucket_id,'object_path',fa.object_path,
   'original_filename',fa.original_filename,'mime_type',fa.mime_type,
   'size_bytes',fa.size_bytes) order by df.ordinal)
   from public.deliverable_files df join public.file_assets fa on fa.id=df.asset_id
   where df.deliverable_version_id=cp.version_id and fa.status='ready'),'[]'::jsonb),

   'created_at',cf.created_at,'author_name',coalesce(pr.display_name,'Cliente'))
   order by cf.created_at,cf.id) from public.client_feedback cf
   left join public.profiles pr on pr.user_id=cf.author_id where cf.publication_id=cp.id),'[]'::jsonb))
 into v_result from public.client_publications cp

 join public.projects p on p.id=cp.project_id join public.brands b on b.id=p.brand_id
 join public.client_reviews cr on cr.publication_id=cp.id

 where cp.id=publication_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.project_member_candidates(project_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, display_name text, email text, member_type text, suggested_responsibility text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  target_agency uuid;
  target_organization uuid;
begin
  if not app_private.can_manage_project_members(project_id) then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'project_member_candidates_forbidden';
  end if;
  select o.agency_id, o.id into target_agency, target_organization
  from public.projects as p
  join public.brands as b on b.id = p.brand_id
  join public.organizations as o on o.id = b.organization_id
  where p.id = project_id;

  return query
  select candidates.user_id, candidates.display_name, candidates.email,
    candidates.member_type, candidates.suggested_responsibility
  from (
    select am.user_id, coalesce(pr.display_name, au.email, am.user_id::text) as display_name,
      au.email::text as email, 'internal'::text as member_type,
      case when am.role_key = 'project_manager' then 'lead' else 'member' end::text as suggested_responsibility
    from public.agency_memberships as am
    left join public.profiles as pr on pr.user_id = am.user_id
    left join auth.users as au on au.id = am.user_id
    where am.agency_id = target_agency and am.status = 'active'

    union all

    select cm.user_id, coalesce(pr.display_name, au.email, cm.user_id::text),
      au.email::text, 'client'::text, 'client_member'::text
    from public.client_memberships as cm
    left join public.profiles as pr on pr.user_id = cm.user_id
    left join auth.users as au on au.id = cm.user_id
    where cm.organization_id = target_organization and cm.status = 'active'
  ) as candidates
  left join public.project_memberships as existing
    on existing.project_id = project_member_candidates.project_id
    and existing.user_id = candidates.user_id and existing.status = 'active'
  where existing.id is null and candidates.user_id <> (select auth.uid())
  order by candidates.member_type, candidates.display_name, candidates.user_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.project_work_items(project_id uuid, page_limit integer DEFAULT 100, page_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(work_item_id uuid, title text, description text, status text, priority text, due_at timestamp with time zone, completed_at timestamp with time zone, archived_at timestamp with time zone, milestone_id uuid, milestone_name text, assignee_ids uuid[], assignee_names text[], can_transition boolean, can_assign boolean, can_archive boolean, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not app_private.project_permission(project_id, 'project.view') then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'project_work_forbidden';
  end if;
  if page_limit not between 1 and 100 or page_offset < 0 then
    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'invalid_work_list_input';
  end if;

  return query
  select wi.id, wi.title, wi.description, wi.status, wi.priority,
    wi.due_at, wi.completed_at, wi.archived_at, m.id, m.name,
    coalesce(assignees.user_ids, '{}'::uuid[]),
    coalesce(assignees.display_names, '{}'::text[]),
    app_private.project_permission(wi.project_id, 'work.transition')
      and (
        not exists (
          select 1 from public.projects p2
          join public.brands b2 on b2.id=p2.brand_id
          join public.organizations o2 on o2.id=b2.organization_id
          join public.agency_memberships am2 on am2.agency_id=o2.agency_id
          where p2.id=wi.project_id and am2.user_id=(select auth.uid())
            and am2.status='active' and am2.role_key='contributor'
        )
        or (select auth.uid()) = any(coalesce(assignees.user_ids, '{}'::uuid[]))
      ),
    app_private.project_permission(wi.project_id, 'work.assign'),
    app_private.project_permission(wi.project_id, 'work.archive'),
    count(*) over ()
  from public.work_items as wi
  left join public.milestones as m on m.id = wi.milestone_id
  left join lateral (
    select array_agg(wia.user_id order by wia.user_id) as user_ids,
      array_agg(coalesce(pr.display_name, au.email, wia.user_id::text) order by wia.user_id) as display_names
    from public.work_item_assignees as wia
    left join public.profiles as pr on pr.user_id = wia.user_id
    left join auth.users as au on au.id = wia.user_id
    where wia.work_item_id = wi.id and wia.revoked_at is null
  ) as assignees on true
  where wi.project_id = project_work_items.project_id
    and app_private.can_read_work_item(wi.id)
  order by (wi.archived_at is not null),
    case wi.status when 'blocked' then 0 when 'in_progress' then 1 when 'todo' then 2 when 'done' then 3 else 4 end,
    case wi.priority when 'urgent' then 0 when 'high' then 1 when 'normal' then 2 else 3 end,
    wi.due_at nulls last, wi.created_at desc, wi.id
  limit page_limit offset page_offset;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS jsonb

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_variable
begin
  if not app_private.project_permission(project_id,'project.view')
    or (deliverable_id is not null and not exists(select 1 from public.deliverables d
      where d.id=deliverable_id and d.project_id=project_id)) then
    raise exception using errcode='42501',message='review_configuration_forbidden'; end if;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'can_configure',app_private.project_permission(project_id,'review.configure'),
    'requirements',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',rr.id,
      'reviewer_id',rr.reviewer_id,'reviewer_name',coalesce(pr.display_name,'Miembro'),
      'scope',case when rr.deliverable_id is null then 'project' else 'deliverable' end)
      order by rr.created_at,rr.id) from public.review_requirements rr
      left join public.profiles pr on pr.user_id=rr.reviewer_id
      where rr.project_id=review_configuration.project_id and rr.active
        and rr.deliverable_id is not distinct from review_configuration.deliverable_id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'candidates',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('user_id',c.user_id,
      'display_name',coalesce(pr.display_name,'Miembro')) order by pr.display_name,c.user_id)
      from (select distinct am.user_id from public.projects p
        join public.brands b on b.id=p.brand_id join public.organizations o on o.id=b.organization_id
        join public.agency_memberships am on am.agency_id=o.agency_id and am.status='active'
        where p.id=review_configuration.project_id and
          app_private.phase7_reviewer_eligible(p.id,am.user_id)) c
